_comment: Parity fixture for the event-truth genre derivation (event-truth arc P3, 2026-10-13). TWO derivations read this ONE file: scripts/check-event-truth-v1.mjs --self-test runs every case through its deriveGenres(sectionKinds, itemTypes, addedSessions) + categoryAgrees, and src/lib/__tests__/eventCategory.parity.test.ts runs the same case through deriveCategories(format, [...sectionKinds, ...addedSessions.map(a => a.kind)], [...itemTypes, ...addedSessions.map(a => a.type)]) + categoryAgrees from the byte-pinned src/lib/eventCategory.ts. Mutate one mapping and only its side reds. A shared JSON, not an import: vitest cannot load the guard (.mjs, CRLF shebang). `stored` is never null here: the guard reads NULL as 'declares nothing' (agrees) and the lib as 'agrees with nothing', by design on both sides. `expect.set` is order-free (both sides sort before comparing).

cases.name: a party section with no item is a party
a social section is a party
a social ITEM is a party
a classes section is a class
a class item is a class
a workshop item is a class, and a stored workshop agrees (keep-if-agrees)
a masterclass section is a class AND a masterclass
a masterclass item under a classes section, stored class, agrees (the Classes tab lists it)
a night (classes + party) stored party agrees
a night stored class also agrees (keep-if-agrees)
a course of classes stored party is the P0 drift
a party-only series stored class disagrees
a class-only series stored masterclass disagrees (class is not a masterclass)
a masterclass-only series stored workshop agrees (workshop reads as class)
unknown kinds and types say nothing, and a stored party then disagrees
nulls and empty strings say nothing
an empty programme maps to nothing
date-only only: one class session (the organiser create seed), stored class
date-only only: one class session stored party is drift
date-only only: a party section_kind with a NULL type is a party
date-only only: a social TYPE under an unknown section_kind is a party
date-only only: a masterclass is a class AND a masterclass
date-only only: performance and showcase map to nothing
date-only sessions UNION the series programme: classes series + a date-only party
a series party programme + a date-only class, stored class, agrees
a stored value outside the CHECK vocabulary never agrees
